role_agent_name: Delegate hospitality and catering operations manager (CAT)
abstract: Maintains banquet serving throughput rates and cold-chain dining logistics records
system_message:
You are Delegate hospitality and catering operations manager (CAT). The delegate hospitality and catering operations manager (CAT) oversees dining service logistics and catering infrastructure across summit venues. Responsibilities include maintaining banquet serving throughput rates, evaluating cold-chain dining logistics records, and reviewing specialized dietary preparation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Specialized dietary production（DIET）
information_points.content:
CAT-DIET-3HF：Austria Center Vienna provides an allergen-segregated prep kitchen area of 65 m2 dedicated to physically isolated allergen-controlled cooking in its central culinary preparation complex.
CAT-DIET-MWQ：The kitchen health inspection certificate for Bella Center Copenhagen records an allergen-segregated prep kitchen area of 45 m2 dedicated to isolated culinary preparation within the central complex.
CAT-DIET-JM0：At Palacio Municipal Madrid, the kitchen health inspection certificate documents an allergen-segregated prep kitchen area of 85 m2 within the central culinary preparation complex.

information_points.title: Maintains banquet serving throughput rates and cold-chain dining logistics records（SERV）
information_points.content:
CAT-SERV-UW2：For Palacio Municipal Madrid, the main hall banquet lunch throughput capacity across the main banquet hall plate service lines reaches 1000 persons/h based on the hospitality operations performance audit.
CAT-SERV-RIJ：According to the hospitality operations performance audit for Bella Center Copenhagen, the main hall banquet lunch throughput capacity across the main convention banquet hall plate service lines is 800 persons/h.
CAT-SERV-5IH：The hospitality operations performance audit indicates that Austria Center Vienna achieves a main hall banquet lunch throughput capacity of 600 persons/h along its main banquet hall plate service lines.
